```python
is_delete_application = And(
    Txn.on_completion() == OnComplete.DeleteApplication,
    Txn.application_id() != Int(0),
    Txn.sender() == App.creator() # Ensure only the creator can delete
)
```

    Txn.asset_close_to() == Global.zero_address(), # Added this check

    Txn.asset_receiver() == asset_receiver_1
